input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: § 14.10 restricts only Customer's assignment and is silent on IBM, so IBM could transfer the Agreement freely (including to our competitor) while our transfers require consent — the clause fails the fallback's mutuality requirement on a material term. It also lacks the affiliate and sale-of-substantially-all-assets carve-outs (only merger/consolidation/acquisition successors are covered). Positively, there is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right for IBM anywhere in the Agreement, so this is not walk-away territory. Redline makes the restriction mutual with a not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard, bars assignment to a Customer competitor, and adds the affiliate/asset-sale carve-out, reaching the preferred position.

proposal.summary: Make assignment restriction mutual and add affiliate / asset-sale carve-out for Customer
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the assignment restriction mutual (IBM's assignment now requires our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to our competitor) and added the customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets. As drafted the restriction bound only us while IBM could transfer the Agreement freely.

ops.oldText: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Neither party will assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and IBM will not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Customer. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement, without consent, to an affiliate or to a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets.
